## Q6 - Supplemental Function


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(bio3d) # necessary library import

analyze_pdb <- function(pdb_ids = c()) { #uses a vector for 
  #pdb ids to hold a variable number of pdb ids, generalizable
  #for any number of pdb ids of reasonable length
  
  for (id in pdb_ids) { # iterate through each PDB ID provided
    
    pdb <- read.pdb(id) # read the PDB structure from the online 
    # database
    
    chainA <- trim.pdb(pdb, chain = "A", elety = "CA") # limit to 
    #c hain A alpha-carbon atoms only
    
    # secure B-factor values from pdb information
    b_factors <- chainA$atom$b
    
    # plot B-factors with and include properties of the graph 
    # that were used in the original set
    plotb3(b_factors,
           sse = chainA,
           typ = "l",
           ylab = "B-factor",
           main = paste("Protein:", id)) #this last line adds 
    # an annotation that states which protein this graph is for
    # and what its pdb ID is
    
    #the graph is realistically the only function output
    #There is no indication of a necessary value or values to be
    #returned
  }
}

# Example usage:
analyze_pdb(c("4AKE", "1AKE", "1E4Y"))
```
